selection.method: outcome-blind SHA-256 rank over all 100 integer block IDs
selection.registration_caveat: The selection was frozen after the original REBOUND execution but before any independent DOP853 final outcomes. Its function reads only a public seed and integer block IDs, not outcomes.

classification.injection_rule: minimum annually sampled osculating perihelion is strictly below 29.999999 AU

statistics.effect_definition: source minus control annually sampled-injection fraction
statistics.effect_classification_rule: positive or negative only if the paired-block bootstrap interval excludes zero; equivalent only if the full interval is inside the locked margin

prelock_rationale.scientific_comparison_gates: The population-level cross-software thresholds were fixed before the final independent run and are at least as strict as the original annual-sampling convergence gates for injection fraction, identity disagreement, survival, and source-control effect.
prelock_rationale.roundtrip_gate: The 1e-10 element-conversion gate was fixed after a deterministic input-only audit found a maximum selected-block conversion error of 3.717559593496844e-11 AU; this audit did not integrate or inspect final outcomes.
prelock_rationale.numerical_gates: The active-body conservation, endpoint-consistency, source-stability, and checkpoint gates were fixed after the external DE441/Horizons and 100-year operational qualifications passed.

scientific_scope: Independently integrate 10000 hash-selected matched massless tracers per arm for 10000 years with SciPy DOP853, then compare population observables and the candidate-9118 source-control effect against the locked REBOUND MERCURIUS result.
limitations: This is a 10000-year dynamical screen, not a Solar-System-age integration.
The independent run reuses the locked physical assumptions and initial states intentionally; it tests software and numerical-method dependence, not model dependence.
SciPy DOP853 is independent of REBOUND MERCURIUS, but both use binary64 arithmetic on the same machine class.
Only 10000 of the original 100000 tracers per arm are independently replicated.
The hash-ranked selection was registered after the original REBOUND execution, so it is outcome-blind but not a preregistration made before the reference experiment.
The inner Solar System is collapsed into one monopole at the initial epoch.
Candidate 9118 elements are a declared model assumption, not a JPL state or a new observational fit.
Only candidate 9118 is tested; the result does not cover the wider source-parameter space.
The proposal is not an observed TNO population model or survey selection function.
Perihelion minima are sampled annually rather than continuously event-located.
The test particles are massless and do not interact with one another.
nonclaim: Passing can show that the locked 10000-year source-control conclusion is robust to this independent software and integrator on the selected population. It cannot detect or exclude Planet X, validate candidate 9118, or convert a simulated effect into observational evidence.

allowed_verdicts.PASSED: All numerical-validity and cross-software population gates pass; claim remains SCREENING_ONLY.
allowed_verdicts.CONFLICT: Numerical validity passes but one or more locked cross-software population gates fail.
allowed_verdicts.INVALID: One or more locked numerical-validity gates fail.
